rationales: This is the unit of velocity, not acceleration.
This is also the unit of velocity, not acceleration.
Acceleration is measured in metres per second squared.
This is not the SI unit of acceleration.
Torque is the turning effect of a force.
Force is the rate of change of momentum.
Work is the product of force and displacement.
Distance is a measure of separation, not momentum change per time.
N·m is the unit of torque or work.
N·s⁻¹ is not the SI unit of momentum.
kg·m·s⁻² is the unit of force.
Momentum is measured in kg·m·s⁻¹.
One litre equals 1000 cm³.
One litre is not 100 cm³.
One litre is not 10 cm³.
One litre is not 1 cm³.
The sum of position vectors need not be zero for equilibrium.
ΣF = 0 is the first condition of equilibrium.
ΣP = 0 is not the mathematical form of the second condition.
The second condition requires the sum of torques to be zero.
Power is work done per unit time, W/t.
W/t² is not the formula for power.
W²/t is not the formula for power.
W²/t² is not the formula for power.
Work is maximum at 0° because force and displacement are aligned.
At 60°, work is less than its maximum value.
At 90°, the force does no work along the displacement.
At 180°, work is negative, not maximum.
A highest centre of gravity indicates unstable equilibrium.
A lowest centre of gravity indicates stable equilibrium.
In neutral equilibrium, the centre of gravity keeps the same height when displaced.
Being situated at the bottom does not define neutral equilibrium.
Oil acts as a lubricant and reduces friction between metal plates.
Water is not the usual lubricant specified for metal plates.
Fine marble powder does not lower friction between metal plates.
Air is not the intended lubricant between metal plates.
Circular motion describes motion along a circular path, not specifically about an axis.
Motion of a body about an axis is rotatory motion.
Vibratory motion is repeated to-and-fro motion.
Random motion has no fixed path or direction.
0.1 mm is not the usual least count of a school screw gauge.
A typical school screw gauge has a least count of 0.01 mm.
1 mm is too large for the usual screw-gauge least count.
0.001 mm is smaller than the usual school screw-gauge least count.
0°F is below the freezing point of water.
Water freezes at 32°F under standard atmospheric pressure.
-273 K is not a valid temperature in the Kelvin scale.
0 K is absolute zero, not the freezing point of water.
10⁴ N·m⁻² is not equal to one pascal.
One pascal equals one newton per square metre.
10² N·m⁻² is not equal to one pascal.
10³ N·m⁻² is not equal to one pascal.
Chemical energy is stored in chemical bonds, not defined as energy of motion.
Potential energy is associated with position or configuration.
Nuclear energy is stored in atomic nuclei.
Kinetic energy is the energy due to motion.
Nuclear energy is stored in atomic nuclei, not coal.
Heat energy is not the form in which energy is stored in coal.
Coal stores energy mainly as chemical energy.
Kinetic energy is energy of motion, not stored in coal.
